home.faqDesc: Didn’t find the answer? Write to us.
home.faq1Q: How are AzTU EduPlatform courses different from ordinary videos?
home.faq1A: Every course is organised into modules and lessons and tracks your progress automatically. Courses are taught by the university’s experts; in-person courses show their schedule and address on the course page.
home.faq2Q: Do I need to pay to start?
home.faq2A: No — every course in the catalogue is free right now. Sign up and enrol straight away.
home.faq3Q: What is the difference between an online and an in-person course?
home.faq3A: An online course is made of videos and materials you work through whenever you like. An in-person course meets in a classroom on a schedule; the dates, the address and the number of seats are on the course page. You can take both kinds at the same time.
home.faq4Q: Will my progress be kept if I switch devices?
home.faq4A: Yes — progress is stored on the server. Sign in on another device and carry on where you left off.
home.faq5Q: Which languages is the platform available in?
home.faq5A: Azerbaijani and English. Switch with the AZ / EN selector in the header.
